blocks.text: The target subscriptions in DSPM refer to the Azure subscriptions that DSPM must monitor. You can add new target subscriptions to the existing onboarded Azure account. DSPM monitors and scans the data stores within the onboarded subscriptions to identify sensitive data, misconfigurations, and vulnerabilities.
You must be assigned either an Administrator role or a custom role with the Configure Monitoring Scope permission in the Zscaler Admin Console.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Cloud Accounts.
On the Cloud Accounts page, select the onboarded account for which you want to add new subscriptions.
Click Manage and select Add Target Subscriptions from the drop-down menu.
The Add Target Subscriptions window appears.
In the Add Target Subscriptions window, enter the following information and click Save:
Subscription ID: Enter the subscription ID.
Subscription Name (Optional): Enter the subscription name.
Business Unit: Select a business unit for the subscription.
Click + Add Subscription to add more subscriptions.
On the Roles and Templates tab, click Azure Onboarding template to download and deploy the template.
